Statement in simplicity

Abraham makes jewelry the slow way, by hand, from materials found close to home.

Glass that would have been thrown away, brass, silver and cow bone are cut, shaped and finished in Kigali. The result is simple on purpose: clean lines, honest materials, a finish that makes people ask where you bought it.

Beautiful and affordable. That is the point.
